Transition Adapter Generator

Joins two components, the same or different. Each side is a socket the component goes into, or a plug that goes into the component's opening. The tolerance is the gap on every side.

Side A (bottom)

Side B (top)

Between the components

From component A's end to component B's end. Positive: the adapter fills the gap (straight, or tapered between different sizes). Zero: the ends meet. Negative: they reach into each other, e.g. one component sliding into the other's opening.
Enter dimensions and click Generate.
Shown and saved in print orientation: side A down. If side B's end is the larger one, turn the adapter over in the slicer, so the tapered middle doesn't overhang. A socket facing down is closed by a flat ceiling, which the printer bridges.
